reader.requirement: Every program of the run unit that describes an external Working-Storage record (any record-name match, its own subordinate descriptions, or a complete REDEFINES of it per X.4.5.4 GR2) references one and the same storage, whether the programs are contained, siblings or separately compiled; group and elementary items, COMP and variable-occurrence items included.

edition-consulted.switches: construct value-clause-linkage-file-external-2002: a VALUE clause on an EXTERNAL item is refused at 85 (X.4.5.3 SR3) and admitted from 2002; refusal side only, not the sharing path
construct external-type-declaration-2023 (STRONG TYPEDEF EXTERNAL); unreachable for a plain 1985 EXTERNAL record

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|Constructs over LinkageBinder, DataBinder.ClausePlacement, OoEmitter, Runtime/Control/ExternalTable and ConstructRegistry.g.cs (external rows: external-type-declaration-2023, externalized-name-as-2002, value-clause-linkage-file-external-2002); the binding, cell emission and runtime table are edition-free
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the sharing is the same; only the refusal of VALUE on an EXTERNAL item and the AS phrase differ (later-edition additions)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf31_04 shares one DISPLAY record between a program and two contained programs; not a separately compiled sibling, a REDEFINES of the whole external record, COMP or variable-occurrence subordinate items, or a contained program of a separately compiled program

reader.notes: Each describer's external record is re-based onto one run-unit StorageCell keyed by the upper-folded record name (ExternalTable.Cell), so every describer aliases one image regardless of its subordinate layout. Probed with programs in one source file (siblings and contained); a run unit assembled from separately compiled object files on disk was not probed, as the same runtime table serves both.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:X.1.3.6, X.4.5.1-X.4.5.4 and X.2.4.1. The reader did not probe a separately compiled describer: sep/p2sub.cob compiled alone at --std 85 (runs/p2sub-001), its p2sub.dll put beside p2main.cob (runs/p2main-001): P2SUB (01 REDEFINES of the whole external record, X.4.5.4 GR2) printed 'SUB SEES MAINXX +0010', MAIN then 'MAIN AFTER SUB +0015 SUBSET' and its 88 under the external item 'MAIN 88 SUB TRUE' (X.4.5.3 SR3 second sentence: the 88 VALUE is admitted at 85); contained INITIAL P2INI describing EXT-R: 'INI 1 +0016 SUBSET' / 'INI 1 +0017 INITXX' (LOC reinitialized each call, the external data not: X.2.4.1 GR1 covers internal data only); after CANCEL P2SUB the next call 'SUB SEES INITXX +0017' (external storage survives CANCEL). p2g.cob (runs/p2g-001): a GLOBAL EXTERNAL record used by a contained program through the global name, redescribed locally in lower case by a doubly contained program, and an elementary EXTERNAL item described as a group elsewhere: 'H GLOBAL AAA 123 EXT WW/WW', 'I OWN AAA124', 'G III 999 WWZZ', one storage throughout.
